attributes.method: For each of the six cheapest mechanism-less pins named by claim.CX_mechanism-sketches-for-the-forty-one-mechanism-less-webfrank-pins.20260904.v1 (minus gendir_8004FBC8, inside game/enemy/enemy, which claude-fleet-worker-AL owns this run): read the residual with `wf_word_diff.py <unit> <fn> --list` and the aligned pre-postprocess view with `fnasm.py <unit> <fn> --diff --raw`; take a clean `probe.py <unit> <fn> --raw --ops` baseline; then run up to three source probes in DISTINCT construct classes, arbitrated on the RAW differing-word count because a pinned function's objdiff fuzzy reads 100% by construction. attributes.why_it_matters: CX's census supplied the MECHANISM half for 41 bare-boolean pins and said explicitly that it did not supply PROVENANCE. This claim pays the provenance half for six of them by actually probing the source, which is the only thing that can distinguish 'the allocator did this' from 'nobody tried'. The distinction is not academic: one of the six closed at source on the second probe, so its rule was never necessary, and the other five now carry a probed_form-grade derivation inside the config file the provenance audit reads.

subject: project:gdl
value:
SIX CHEAP PINS PROBED AT SOURCE, RUN 53. ONE PROMOTED, FIVE ANNOTATED, AND THE MECHANISM-LESS COUNT FELL 41 -> 35 WITH NO CHANGE TO THE RULE TOTAL.

CENSUS FIRST, measured on config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json rather than quoted: at the lane's base commit c7b741799 the file held 155 rule entries over 53 units, 114 carrying a `mechanism` string and 41 carrying none. At the lane's tip it holds 155 entries over 53 units, 120 with a mechanism and 35 without. The arithmetic is exactly the six rows this lane touched: five gained prose, one was deleted outright, and one NEW rule (game/pb/dbgtext::fn_800C03E0) shipped WITH a mechanism, which is why the total is unchanged at 155. Note the discrepancy against CX's own figures (154 entries, 113 with mechanism, 41 without, at c0f978273): one rule carrying a mechanism landed between the two commits, so the 41 is the same 41 and the totals are not. Quote the live count, not either of these.

THE PROMOTION (1). game/game/combat::MissileCollideEnemy, 86 insns, 4 words. CLOSED SOURCE-EXACT on probe 2 -- raw words 4 -> 0, real 8 -> 0, `fndiff --clean` EXACT, rule DELETED in the same commit ef1c1e323, split STRICT 57.17% (2593) -> 57.20% (2594) and EQUIVALENT 11.56% (154) -> 11.53% (153) with combined matched flat at 68.73%. The lever was transposing ONE adjacent pair of assignments inside a block; the full derivation is in attempt.WR_missilecollideenemy-promoted-at-source-by-sinking-one-initialiser-and-its-rule-deleted.20260904.v1.

THE FIVE KEPT PINS, each capped at three probes with the derivation now in its own `mechanism` key -- read it there, this is the index:
  game/sys/sysservice::sysClearFlags  4 insns, 2 words, one g0->g4 pair. THREE probes (compound assignment respelled as explicit read-modify-write; named local copy; named local with an intervening update) ALL NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL at one hash, 204b96a5fea6.
  game/pb/dbgtext::dbgTextInit  6 insns, 5 words, a clean g0<->g3 involution. THREE probes (colour constant as its own symbol; the SHARED zero carrier as its own symbol; both, with declaration order varied) ALL NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL at one hash, 397bcd36ef10.
  game/sfx/sfx::DmgFxAdd  107 insns, 4 words, an FPR scratch run f0,f2 against retail's f2,f3. THREE probes: expression fusion REGRESSED 4 -> 6; one carrier split reached codegen as a SCORE-BLIND REARRANGEMENT with SLOT MAP IDENTICAL and stayed at 4; a second carrier split REGRESSED 4 -> 13 and left the recolourable class on frame growth.
  game/anim/anim::InitAnim  106 insns, 4 words, a four-value FPR permutation in the s16-to-double scale window. THREE probes: operand order 4 -> 7 (and its aligned view proves operand order and home assignment are COUPLED -- buying the order cost every home); hoisting a multiplicand into an f64 local 4 -> 17 on frame growth; outer association back to 4 as a different colouring of the same size.
  game/sys/memcard::add_vmu_file  79 insns, 5 words, a base-accumulator split plus an in-place-versus-distinct shift destination. THREE probes measuring 7, 6 and 6 words against the shipped source's 5 -- THE SHIPPED SOURCE IS THE MEASURED MINIMUM OF FOUR SPELLINGS. Its stale dateless `PARKED 79/79 real 10` header comment was retired in the same commit, per the AGENTS.md rule that a header claim which would stop someone needs a date and a falsification command.

THE NEGATIVE HALF, which is the part worth carrying forward. Across the six functions, EIGHTEEN source probes ran: 1 closed, 7 folded away before codegen (NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL), 3 reached codegen and rearranged without improving, and 7 regressed. The folds are not distributed at random. Every probe on the two SMALLEST functions folded -- all six of them, at one hash each -- because sysClearFlags and dbgTextInit have no declaration list, no types, no lifetimes and one or three statements, so there is no source surface for the front end to carry to the allocator. Every probe that ADDED A LOCAL to a function with FP temporaries regressed hard and took the residual out of the recolourable class entirely, twice, on two different TUs (DmgFxAdd 4 -> 13 with 7 IMMEDIATE words, InitAnim 4 -> 17 with 13), because the extra slot moves the frame. And the ONE probe that closed anything changed neither declarations nor spelling but the ORDER of two adjacent assignments. THE PRACTICAL ORDERING that falls out, for the remaining 35: try adjacent-statement transposition FIRST, treat carrier splitting as second and frame-taxed, and do not spend probes at all on a leaf whose values are all compile-time constants consumed by global stores.
